summary: Austin-based software entrepreneur Mike Adams, the self-styled Health Ranger, built Natural News and a web of linked sites that spread anti-vaccine, quack-cure and far-right conspiracy content to millions from the late 1990s on.

evidence.note: self-written bio gives birth in 1967 in Lawrence, Kansas

secret ties to two herbal and supplement MLMs he promoted as independent
article tying Microsoft and Bill Gates to a depopulation bioweapon plot
site runs a homeopathic Ebola remedy recipe using infected samples
